summary: Kimi Antonelli storms into Monza as Ferrari's championship hope, but Italy's tifosi face an identity crisis choosing between backing their homegrown driver and demanding Scuderia glory. Pierre Gasly's shock Alpine pole shatters Mercedes' straightline dominance and sets up a desperate battle as Hamilton admits Ferrari still trails in raw pace despite engine gains. Victory here could reshape the title fight entirely, giving either Ferrari or Alpine unexpected momentum against the championship favorites heading into the season's final stretch.
